assumptions.choice: Higher timeframes are built by manual resampling inside the strategy and every indicator is computed manually in-code (uniform across 1D/4H/60m); custom indicator classes Supertrend and VPT are provided as in-code classes.
assumptions.reason: The harness runs the strategy with a single injected 60m PandasData feed and adds Cerebro itself; a Strategy cannot call cerebro.resampledata at runtime, so 'Use Backtrader resampledata for 4H/1D' cannot be executed literally. Manual resampling plus manual indicators is the closest literal reading and keeps the three timeframes computed identically.

assumptions.choice: Daily bars grouped by calendar date; 4H bars grouped by midnight-anchored 4-hour blocks (hour//4). A higher-timeframe bar is finalized and its score updated when the first 60m bar of the next period arrives (completed-bar semantics).
assumptions.reason: Deterministic replacement for backtrader's resample bucketing/boundary delivery, which cannot be used here.

assumptions.choice: The 15 listed signals are summed and the total is clamped to [-10,+10].
assumptions.reason: The spec lists 15 signals (natural range +/-15) but states the score domain is [-10,+10]; clamping honors the stated domain.

assumptions.choice: Slow stochastic: raw %K over 14, %K line = SMA(3) of raw %K, %D = SMA(3) of %K. 'K crossing above D below 20' = %K crosses above %D with %K<20; 'crossing below above 80' = %K crosses below %D with %K>80.
assumptions.reason: Spec gives Stochastic(14) and crossing wording but not the smoothing/level detail; matched to backtrader's default slow stochastic.

assumptions.choice: slope(5) = value[t] - value[t-5]; up if >0, down if <0, applied to OBV, AccumDist and VPT.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'slope(5)' without defining it; a 5-bar difference is the standard reading.

assumptions.choice: Donchian high/low use the highest-high/lowest-low over the prior 20 bars (current bar excluded); the channel-breakout signal and the order-block trigger compare the current close to those levels.
assumptions.reason: If the current bar were included, close could never exceed the highest high, so 'close above Donchian high' would be unreachable; excluding the current bar is the only consistent literal reading.

assumptions.choice: 'Most recent down/up candle' = nearest prior bar with close<open (down) / close>open (up); the block persists until a new breakout/breakdown replaces it; 'price within candle high/low range' uses the current 60m close.
assumptions.reason: Spec defines the proxy conceptually but not the candle test, persistence, or which price; chose the most direct interpretation.

assumptions.choice: Bracket stop (2*ATR) and take-profit (3*ATR) are computed from the signal-bar close as an entry-price proxy; the entry itself is a Market order (fills next open); sizing uses backtrader's default sizer via buy_bracket/sell_bracket.
assumptions.reason: Bracket child prices must be set at submission before the actual fill is known; canonical default 1 dictates default sizing.

assumptions.choice: Enabled by default (use_trailing). Uses ATR(10) captured at entry; activates once price reaches entry +/-1*ATR (intrabar high/low), trails at 2*ATR from highest-high (long)/lowest-low (short); a breach (intrabar low/high) exits at market after cancelling the bracket's protective orders.
assumptions.reason: Spec labels trailing 'Optional' but describes it fully; modifying live bracket children is not clean in backtrader, so the trail (always tighter than the fixed 2*ATR stop) is enforced by a managed market close. ATR-at-entry chosen for determinism/consistency with the initial stop.

assumptions.choice: Early exit and trailing exit call self.close() after cancelling the outstanding bracket stop/limit (OCO) children.
assumptions.reason: Leaving OCO children live after a manual close could reopen a position; they must be cancelled.

assumptions.choice: 'Daily filter no longer supports the position' = daily score falls below the entry threshold that permitted the trade (long: daily<+3; short: daily>-3).
assumptions.reason: Spec does not define 'no longer supports'; tied it to the same threshold that gated entry.

assumptions.choice: Standard ATR-band trend-switch algorithm; initial direction assumed up on the first ATR-ready bar; direction in {+1 up, -1 down}.
assumptions.reason: Spec names Supertrend(10,3) with band/switch behavior but not the seed; the arbitrary initial direction self-corrects within a few bars.

assumptions.choice: Each timeframe engine requires 50 completed bars (binding: EMA(50)) before its score can gate entries; before then, unavailable sub-signals contribute 0.
assumptions.reason: Manual analogue of backtrader's automatic minperiod (canonical default 6); EMA(50) cannot exist before 50 bars.

assumptions.choice: RSI and ATR use Wilder smoothing (SMMA); EMA seeded with SMA(period); MACD/CCI/Williams %R/MFI use standard textbook formulas, matching backtrader defaults.
assumptions.reason: Reproduces backtrader's built-in definitions since real bt.indicators cannot run on the manually-resampled higher timeframes.

assumptions.choice: SMA(10/50/100/200) and Volume SMA(20) are not instantiated; Bollinger mid (SMA20) is computed for its signal.
assumptions.reason: The spec lists indicators 'as needed' and no rule references these; omitting them has no effect on the execution trace.
